followUps.title: fix(plugins): two defects shipped as documented caveats — WORKER_CONCURRENCY never reaches the runtime, and @netscript/plugin-streams root exports always throw
test(e2e): the merge-readiness gate probes API health only — background children and streams go unverified, and a saga stuck compensating is reported COMPENSATED
fix(scaffold): the generated service ships `/api` unprotected and a framework test codifies public API routes as correct
fix(auth): `POST /api/v1/auth/signout` revokes any session id an unauthenticated caller supplies
fix(auth): oRPC `signin`/`callback` discard the backend `Set-Cookie`, so the interactive browser flow can never establish a session
fix(service): the default CORS policy is `origin: '*'`, which makes credentialed browser calls impossible on every generated and plugin service
test(e2e): the scaffold runtime auth gate proves only that an unauthenticated request succeeds
fix(workers): documented web-worker/subprocess runner modes are unimplemented — docs truthing or Tier-3 pool implementation
fix(cli): Garnet executable arm binds host port 6379 regardless of Aspire allocation
test(sagas): no coverage proves publish survives unavailable API, restart, duplicate publish, or out-of-order delivery
auth-kv-oauth: assertHttps is proxy-blind while deriveHttps is proxy-aware, so the OAuth flow refuses any TLS-terminating-proxy deployment
doctor: `plugin_registry` reports a missing registry and prescribes a remedy the generator provably cannot satisfy
fix(ai): keep published TanStack adapter ranges peer-compatible with AI core
fix(fresh/sdk): align TanStack DB adapter family; mixed Collection runtimes crash stream-query SSR
fix(fresh): route.href hides useContext and corrupts island hook order / navigation
Desktop SDK 0.0.7: window-scoped pending receive prevents client reconnection after document reload
fix(ai/anthropic): Claude 5.5 IDs rejected locally on 0.0.7; qualify forward-compatible model support
service/sdk: no documented internal (service-to-service) procedure lane; nothing provisions the credential and the OpenAPI projection is an easy bypass
plugin-workers-core: JobContext has no AbortSignal or deadline, so handlers cannot observe timeout, shutdown or cancel
fresh/ai: createNetScriptChatConnection.send narrows UIMessages to text, blocking adoption of the #1583 single-subscriber fix
0.0.8 milestone run: orchestrated delivery of milestone 25
ci(e2e): make scaffold.runtime tiers robust to slow container image pulls and Aspire convergence on GitHub runners
fix(auth-workos): implement subject-wide session revocation for signout everywhere
ci: shard check-test and cache dependencies and images to cut CI wall time

releaseBody:
# NetScript 0.0.8-canary.3

**What this canary is for.** canary.3 is the third release candidate on the way to NetScript 0.0.8. It bundles the 61 pull requests merged since canary.2 so downstream apps can try them against real published packages before 0.0.8 ships. It is a **pre-release**: normal semver resolution never selects it, and **Latest stays v0.0.7**. All 35 `@netscript/*` packages are published at exactly `0.0.8-canary.3`, and the canary's publish run and its version-pinned production E2E both passed ([publish](https://github.com/rickylabs/netscript/actions/runs/38059950011), [production E2E](https://github.com/rickylabs/netscript/actions/runs/38060469468)).

## Highlights

- **Durable commands, end to end.** A PostgreSQL command store with a true transaction client (#2093), a durable outbox relayed through checked sinks (#2096), bounded command tracing with privacy conformance (#2094), and sagas that commit typed worker effects atomically with their state transitions (#2097). Sagas also persist `.compensate()` outcomes with a terminal compensated status (#2139).
- **Secure-by-default services and auth.** Services must declare their auth policy (#2220) and their CORS origins (#2193). Signout is owner-scoped (#2177), auth cookies are stricter and propagate on REST and RPC (#2189), trusted-proxy policy is unified (#2188), and services gain internal-audience procedures and a file-reference service credential (#2166).
- **Plugins compose safely.** Root composition rejects identity collisions, unknown contribution keys and missing dependencies (#2125); plugin host ports survive re-installs (#2175).
- **Fresh, SDK and desktop fixes reported by downstream apps.** One TanStack DB Collection runtime across Fresh and the SDK (#2089), pure typed route `href` helpers that no longer hide hooks (#2090), desktop RPC reconnects after a document reload (#2091), complete native chat messages (#2092), an injectable `resolveServiceUrl` (#2183), and query factories that keep required context (#2209).
- **AI.** Explicitly configured Anthropic model IDs, including Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Fable 5.1, with current wire options (#2078), on a peer-compatible TanStack AI family (#2087, #2126).
- **Workers, queue and KV.** Job cancellation and deadlines (#2088, documented in #2204), trace context forwarded into queue subprocesses (#2136), named queues isolated within one Deno KV database (#2140), and memory/Redis KV adapters conformant on atomic versionstamps (#2135).
- **CLI and Aspire.** Generated resources resolve multi-namespace clients (#2171), remote Docker daemon topology is diagnosed (#2173), the Garnet executable gets an allocated port (#2199), and the MCP server ranks guidance by content (#2124) and warns on unknown plugin registry expectations (#2216).

## Breaking changes and migration

- **Explicit CORS (#2193).** Services no longer default to wildcard CORS. Set `NETSCRIPT_CORS_ORIGINS='https://app.example,https://admin.example'` for services and plugins, or pass `cors: { origin: [...] }` to `defineService` / `createPluginService` (`.withCors({ origin: [...] })` on builders). Unset origins deny cross-origin browser calls, and wildcard plus credentials fails `build()`. Generated CLI/Aspire helpers inject your enabled web apps' origins, so scaffolded projects keep working.
- **Explicit service auth policy (#2220).** `defineService()` no longer treats a missing policy as public. Pass `auth: { authn: { authenticator }, authz: { authorizer } }` (authorization is optional). For a genuinely public service, pass `auth: { public: true, reason: '…' }` with a non-blank reason. The service README and CHANGELOG show the before and after.
- **Owner-scoped signout (#2177).** Anonymous signout returns `401`, `sessionId` must be one of the caller's own sessions, and `everywhere` revokes all of the caller's sessions. Revoking another user's session needs `revokeSession` with `auth:sessions:revoke`. Custom `AuthSessionStorePort`, `KvOAuthStore` and `BetterAuthInstance` implementations each gain one method; see the auth docs callout "Breaking in 0.0.8: migrating signout callers". `plugin auth session list` now needs a credential.
- **Validated plugin composition (#2125).** Unknown contribution keys fail, every declared plugin dependency must be composed, and `@netscript/plugin-triggers` no longer declares pseudo-dependencies on the `*-core` libraries. Migration notes are in the plugin README and reference page.
- **Stricter auth cookies (#2189).** `HttpOnly=false` and insecure custom-name cookies are refused outside an explicit development policy, and `KvOAuthCookieOptions.httpOnly` is typed `true`.

## Known open follow-ups

- **Scaffolded auth wiring.** `service add` does not yet wire the authenticator automatically when the auth plugin is installed (#1382, in review), and the scaffolded browser-to-backend auth topology is queued for canary.4 (#1386).
- **Callback session credential.** Its removal from the public callback JSON is queued for canary.4 (#1385).
- **Downstream-reported fixes.** Qualification against these published packages is in progress, and the issues close as each one is proven: #2039, #2040, #2041, #2068, #2066, #2036.
- **Saga process-restart and ordering proof.** Queued for canary.4 (#1826).

## Trying this canary

Pin exact versions, for example `jsr:@netscript/service@0.0.8-canary.3`. Deno 2.9 applies a default 24-hour minimum dependency age, so a canary less than a day old will not resolve until that window passes. For testing before then, set `minimumDependencyAge: 0` in the consumer's configuration; that changes only admission timing, not versions. The generated list below includes partial-scope PRs as "closes no linked issues": they reference their issues without closing them, and the remaining scope stays tracked there.
